headline: Livelo Appoints Carla Nesi as First Female CEO
summary: Carla Nesi, an executive with over three decades at Banco do Brasil, has assumed leadership of Livelo as its first female CEO.
why: Management changes at prominent fintech and loyalty companies signal strategic shifts that can influence market positioning and operational focus.
